subtitle_html: All MicTest tools and pages, organised by category.

content_blocks.html:
Main

  • Microphone Test — Test your mic directly in the browser

Mic Tools

  • Show My Mic — Identify your connected microphone device
  • Mic Recorder — Record and play back your voice in the browser
  • Sound Level Meter — Measure ambient noise in decibels
  • Voice Frequency Analyzer — Visualise the frequency content of your voice
  • Background Noise Analyzer — Detect and categorise background noise by frequency band
  • Echo Test — Check whether your audio setup produces echo
  • Audio Latency Test — Measure the round-trip delay in your audio chain

Speaker Tools

  • Show My Speakers — Identify the speaker or output device in use
  • Tone Generator — Generate sine, square, or sawtooth tones at any frequency
  • Stereo Test — Verify left and right channel separation
  • Bass Test — Check low-frequency response from 20 Hz upward
  • Speaker Volume Test — Calibrate and compare speaker output levels

Headphones & Hearing

  • Headphone Test — Test channel balance, frequency response, and driver health
  • Hearing Test — Check your hearing range across common frequencies

Resources

  • Troubleshooting Guide — Solutions for common microphone and audio issues
  • About MicTest — What MicTest is, how it works, and who built it
  • Contact — Get in touch with a question or feedback
